topic: Sleep architecture: how stages cycle for optimal restoration
caption: Did you know your sleep is divided into 3-5 cycles, each with 3 stages? 🌙💤 Learn how to optimize your sleep architecture for better restoration. Here are the facts: Stage 1: transition to sleep (5-10 minutes), Stage 2: light sleep (20 minutes), Stage 3: deep sleep (30-60 minutes). 📊 REM sleep is crucial for memory consolidation. 💭 And, did you know that sleep pressure builds up during the day and decreases during sleep? 😴 Save this so you don't lose it.
